privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: MinyanNow helps Jewish people find or start a minyan anywhere in the world. We take your privacy seriously.

data.title: Data we collect
data.body: Display name (and optional avatar), a unique anonymous account ID, blurred presence zone (~1 km geohash when you enable presence), minyanim you create or join, chat messages in threads you belong to, trust/participation history, optional analytics (if you opt in), and a push token when push delivery is enabled.

use.title: How we use data
use.body: To show you nearby minyanim, count people in blurred areas, run chats for coordination, maintain trust, and (when available) notify you about nearby activity. We never sell your data.

location.title: Location
location.body: GPS is used only while the app is open — for the map, creating a minyan where you stand, and optional presence. Exact coordinates are not stored for density; we keep only a blurred zone (~1 km). Minyan pins you create store the location you publish for that minyan.

sharing.title: Data sharing
sharing.body: We do not share your personal data with third parties, except essential infrastructure providers (database, push notifications, maps) acting on our behalf under strict data-processing agreements.

retention.title: Retention & deletion
retention.body: You can delete your account at any time from Settings. Your profile, presence, tokens, and related history are removed. Live minyanim expire after their time window.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about your data? Email support@minyannowapp.com
